title: Setting Up a Repayment Plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Console Reference
content:
A claimant sets up a monthly repayment plan on one of the Benefit Overpayment Accounts that has none by agreeing to the monthly installment worked out for it. The new plan carries exactly that installment; its first installment falls due the classification's first-payment days after the plan is set, and later installments fall due on the classification's due day.

## Conditions on setting a plan

A new repayment plan is set only after none of the claimant's other overpayments carries a repayment plan whose status is defaulted.

The repayment plan status shown on each of the claimant's other overpayment records is what decides it: while any of them reads defaulted, no new plan is set on this overpayment.

## What the setup records

Setting up the plan marks the plan status on the overpayment record as current, records the agreed monthly installment, and records the due date of the plan's opening installment as thirty calendar days from the day the plan is set. The remaining installments fall due on the classification's monthly due day.

## The setup tool

The plan is set up with `set_up_repayment_plan_0b609272`, a tool that belongs to the claimant, by which the claimant agrees to a monthly repayment plan. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `overpayment_id` | The reference number of the benefit overpayment the plan is set on, as given to the claimant by the representative from the overpayment record | Reference number |
| `monthly_amount` | The agreed monthly installment, as the representative states it | USD, 2 decimal places (0.00 when no plan); an amount with more decimals is rounded to the nearest cent when recorded |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `overpayment_id`, `repayment_plan_status` (current when the plan was set), `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` (the installment recorded, USD to 2 decimal places) and `repayment_plan_start_date` (the due date of the plan's opening installment, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt showing the status current means the plan is set. If the overpayment reference number matches no overpayment, the reply starts with "Error:" and nothing changes.

*Illustration (hypothetical values):* a plan set on 4 May on overpayment OP-4471 at 38.20 returns `repayment_plan_status` current, `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` 38.2 and `repayment_plan_start_date` 2026-06-03 when the year is 2026.
